descs.t: Ethan Klein of H3 has posted an apology and asked the public to respect his family's privacy after Hila Klein revealed he had been having an affair. Posts online name an employee as the other woman, and an old clip of the two women is circulating again. We walk through what has been said, by whom, and what is still only rumor.

Ethan Klein's apology video has drawn far more mockery than sympathy, and his critics, Hasan Piker's audience among them, are treating the affair as proof of everything they said about him. Does a cheating scandal settle the political fights around H3? We separate the affair from the arguments it is being used to win.

Ethan Klein's affair is his own mess, but watch what his enemies are doing with it: a personal betrayal is being turned into a weapon against his support for Israel, often in openly antisemitic language. We look at the scandal, the apology, and the pile on that has nothing to do with his marriage.

intro.plain: Ethan Klein of H3 is in the middle of an affair scandal. Hila Klein revealed it, he has posted an apology and asked for privacy, and the internet has not given him any. I want to go through what is actually known and what is still rumor. Chat, does an apology video ever help in a situation like this?
intro.mid: So Ethan Klein's weird apology is out, and it is not landing. Hila revealed the affair, posts online name an employee, and an old clip of the two women is going around as if it predicted everything. His critics are celebrating. Here is my question for the chat: does his affair change a single argument he made about Hasan?
intro.bold: Ethan Klein cheated on his wife, Hila revealed it, and his enemies could not be happier. But look at what they are doing with it: a broken marriage turned into a license for open hate. You can think he behaved terribly and still see that. Chat, tell me honestly: is this about his marriage, or about his politics?

hook.plain: Hila Klein revealed the affair, and Ethan Klein answered with an apology and a request for privacy. Here is what has actually been said, and what is still rumor.
hook.mid: An old H3 clip is going viral because it seems to show the affair coming. Ethan Klein has apologized. Now his critics want the scandal to settle every old fight.
hook.bold: Ethan Klein's affair is a personal betrayal. What his enemies are doing with it is something else entirely, and it tells you exactly who they are.

descs.t: New court filings identify Rep. Ilhan Omar by another name, Nur Said Elmi, and President Trump is calling on her to resign, claiming she used a false name to get elected. A 1997 marriage certificate published by the New York Post lists the same family name. We go through the filings, the certificate and what the Justice Department says about its probe.

Ilhan Omar calls the probe right-wing conspiracy theories laundered through the Justice Department, while a DOJ official rejects claims it is politically motivated. With Trump demanding her resignation, the question is whether the paper trail can actually threaten her seat. We lay out what is documented and what is still only alleged.

Ilhan Omar dodged questions on the immigration probe again, while court filings and a 1997 marriage certificate put her past back on the table. Trump says she must resign. We walk through the records and ask why she answers with attacks on the DOJ instead of documents.
